crossRefs.note: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.
I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and…
You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the…
You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and…
You shall not pervert justice. You shall not show partiality. You shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes…
Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
“How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?”
Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?
They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
These also are sayings of the wise. To show partiality in judgment is not good.
who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!
His delight will be in the fear of Yahweh. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of…
but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the…
My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.
haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

translations.web: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”
translations.bsb: Stop judging by outward appearances, and start judging justly.”
translations.kjv: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
translations.asv: Judge not according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
